title: Stop Using the Wrong AI Tool for This
description:
Most people are stuck using outdated AI tools and wondering why their results look mediocre. In this short, I break down the best AI tools across 
5 categories : Research, Presentations, Websites, AI Video, and Studying and rank them Bad, 

Good, and Amazing so you know exactly which one to use.

I tested dozens of AI tools this year to find the ones that consistently outperform everything else. These are the picks that actually deliver professional grade results.

⏱️ What's covered:
• Best AI for Research
• Best AI for Presentations
• Best AI for building Websites
• Best AI for making AI Videos
• Best AI for Studying
